list.title: Framework agreements
list.subtitle: Credit envelopes governing Financings executed with each Leasing Company

emptyState.title: No framework agreements yet
emptyState.description: Create the first agreement to define a credit envelope for a Leasing Company.

emptyFiltered.title: No agreements match your filters
emptyFiltered.description: Try adjusting the search or filters.

identity.title: Identity & counterparty
identity.subtitle: Define the agreement identity and the parties involved.
identity.agreementNameHint: Must be unique for this leasing company and bank entity.
identity.leasingCompanyHint: Only active leasing companies are shown
identity.currencyHint: Currency is fixed at creation and cannot be changed

envelopePricing.title: Envelope & pricing
envelopePricing.subtitle: Set the credit envelope and pricing terms. These values will be inherited by all financings under this agreement.
envelopePricing.maxVolumeHint: Hard ceiling on total disbursable amount under this agreement.
envelopePricing.effectiveRateHint: For Fixed and Floating types, this should equal base rate plus spread.
envelopePricing.coverageOverrideHint: Overrides the standard product template rate where applicable.

validityTemplates.title: Validity & product templates
validityTemplates.subtitle: Set the agreement validity window and select which product templates are permitted under this agreement.
validityTemplates.templatesHint: Only published templates within your tenant are shown. Select at least one.

conditions.title: Special conditions
conditions.subtitle: Document any commercial terms or conditions specific to this agreement. This information is advisory only and does not affect system behavior.
conditions.hint: Enter any special conditions, commercial terms, or notes relevant to this agreement.

documents.title: Framework documents
documents.subtitle: Attach signed framework agreement documents. At least one document is required before the agreement can be activated.
documents.optionalNotice: Documents are optional at this stage. At least one signed document must be attached before the agreement can be activated.
documents.dropzoneLabel: Drag and drop your PDF file here or click to browse
documents.dropzoneHint: PDF only. Max 25 MB per file. Up to 10 documents.

review.title: Review and save
review.subtitle: Review all details before saving. You can return to any step to make changes. The agreement will be saved as Draft. Activation is a separate step.

discardDialog.title: Discard this draft?
discardDialog.description: The draft and any attached documents will be permanently deleted.

wizard.incompleteDraft: Complete the required fields before saving as draft.

createdSuccess.title: Agreement saved as draft
createdSuccess.subtitle: {{name}} has been saved. Review the details and activate the agreement when you are ready. At least one signed document must be attached before activation.

detail.loadError: Something went wrong loading this agreement.

activate.documentsConfirmed: I confirm the required framework documents are attached
activate.justificationHint: Mandatory. Stored in the audit trail.

suspend.justificationHint: Mandatory. Stored in the audit trail.

reactivate.reValidationConfirmed: I confirm the agreement's terms have been re-validated and remain accurate
reactivate.justificationHint: Mandatory. Stored in the audit trail.

terminate.irreversibilityConfirmed: I understand this action is irreversible and cannot be undone
terminate.justificationHint: Mandatory (min. 30 characters). Stored in the audit trail.
terminate.blockedTitle: This agreement cannot be terminated yet
terminate.blockedDescription: {{count}} linked financing is still active. Resolve it before terminating this agreement.
terminate.blockedDescription_other: {{count}} linked financings are still active. Resolve them before terminating this agreement.

documentsTab.limitReachedHint: Maximum of 10 documents reached. Detach a document to attach a new one.

detachConfirm.title: Detach this document?
detachConfirm.description: "{{fileName}}" will be removed from this agreement. This cannot be undone.

edit.lockedFieldHint: Locked — cannot be changed after the agreement leaves Draft.
edit.validUntilLockedHint: This agreement has no end date. An end date cannot be introduced after Draft; it can only be extended once one is set.
edit.templateRemovalHint: Removing a template is blocked if any in-flight financing draft still references it.
edit.justificationHint: Mandatory (min. 30 characters). Stored in the audit trail.
